decisions.reason: NL1 requires start in DoorsClosing. Binding is empty and precise false; deterministic frontier retained unresolved check. No model element reference is supplied, so initial-entry applicability cannot be decided.
decisions.strongest_defeater: A later exact owner/carrier binding could close this check; no identity was inferred from names, display text, or an incomplete ref set.
decisions.violated_obligation: System must start in DoorsClosing state.

decisions.basis: dossier 0034:r1:i3 with NL5, fcstm_model:S2 receipt false
decisions.reason: NL5 requires InMotion begins in Accelerating. S2 transition_exists for scope llms_emp_feedback_final_0034.InMotion source [*] target llms_emp_feedback_final_0034.Accelerating returned false. Inspection shows no owner-local initial entry; only root initial edge [*]->DoorsClosing.
decisions.violated_obligation: InMotion must own an initial pseudostate edge to Accelerating.

decisions.basis: dossier 0034:r1:i4 with NL3, llms_emp_feedback_final_0034.puml:line:8, fcstm_model
decisions.reason: NL3 requires EmergencyStopping sends Obstacle Detected signal. Closed model shows EmergencyStopping enter abstract EmergencyStop and transition on Obstacle_Cleared; Obstacle_Detected is consumed on entry, not produced. No effect emission is present.

decisions.basis: dossier 0034:r1:i5 with NL9, llms_emp_feedback_final_0034.puml:line:16, working_contract lifecycle projection
decisions.reason: NL9 requires Send signal in Approaching. Closed model lifecycle for Approaching is Decelerate; no Send action is recorded. PlantUML shows entry/Decelerate only.

decisions.basis: dossier 0034:r1:i6 with NL10, inspection_equivalent_facts transitions line38/39
decisions.reason: NL10 requires retention while nearing destination. Inspection shows Approaching has outgoing transitions to Stopping on Ready_to_Stop and to [*] on Destination_Missed with no guard or invariant expressing nearing destination retention.
decisions.violated_obligation: Approaching must be retained while nearing destination until ready to stop/decelerate.

issues.basis: exact_source_inventory.states rows for InMotion line5 and Accelerating line13; inspection_equivalent_facts.states state:InMotion:line:13 and state:Accelerating:line:18 with parent llms_emp_feedback_final_0034
issues.expected: Accelerating is a direct substate of InMotion

issues.expected: Cruising is a direct substate of InMotion
issues.observed: Cruising exists as a top-level state sibling to InMotion with no parent containment.
issues.reason: Source inventory parent null for Cruising and closed model parent is root, so containment requirement is not met.
issues.requirement_quote: Within the InMotion state, the system operates in three substates: Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching, which represent different phases of the train's motion.

issues.basis: exact_source_inventory.states Approaching line16 parent null; inspection_equivalent_facts.states state:Approaching:line:24 parent llms_emp_feedback_final_0034
issues.expected: Approaching is a direct substate of InMotion
issues.observed: Approaching is a top-level state with parent root in both source inventory and closed model.
issues.reason: No containment link is present in source or closed model.

issues.basis: NL5 contract binding owner InMotion target Accelerating; inspection_equivalent_facts.states InMotion outgoing refs include transition:line:32 to Accelerating; verify_facts initial-entry check for transition:line:27 only
issues.expected: InMotion owns an initial pseudostate edge to Accelerating
issues.observed: InMotion has outgoing transitions to Accelerating, Cruising and Approaching without triggers, but no owner-local initial entry; the only root initial edge is [*] -> DoorsClosing.
issues.reason: Contract requires owner InMotion to begin in Accelerating; inspection_equivalent_facts shows no initial entry transition owned by InMotion and verify_facts shows initial-entry only for transition:line:27.
issues.requirement_quote: The system begins in the Accelerating substate, moving to the Cruising substate once cruising speed is reached, as indicated by the "Reached Cruising/Cruise" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: A non-triggered InMotion->Accelerating transition exists but is not an initial entry owned by InMotion.
issues.title: InMotion initial entry to Accelerating missing

issues.basis: fcstm_model state EmergencyStopping definition; inspection_equivalent_facts.event_consumers for Obstacle_Detected with consumer state InMotion; transition:line:30 triggers Obstacle_Detected
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping emits Obstacle Detected signal as an effect
issues.observed: EmergencyStopping has enter abstract EmergencyStop and a transition on Obstacle_Cleared to [*]; no effect emitting Obstacle Detected is present, and Obstacle_Detected is a trigger into EmergencyStopping.
issues.reason: Closed model shows no effect emission from EmergencyStopping; event consumer facts show Obstacle_Detected consumed by InMotion transition.
issues.requirement_quote: When an obstacle is detected, the system enters the EmergencyStopping state, which includes the actions "Emergency Stop" and sends the "Obstacle Detected" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Obstacle_Detected is consumed on entry to EmergencyStopping, not produced.
issues.title: EmergencyStopping does not send Obstacle Detected signal

issues.observed: Approaching has enter abstract Decelerate and transitions on Ready_to_Stop and Destination_Missed; no Send signal action is defined.
issues.reason: Closed model lifecycle for Approaching is Decelerate; no Send action is recorded.
issues.requirement_quote: In the Approaching substate, the system sends the "Send" signal and continues to approach the destination.

issues.basis: inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions for Approaching transition:line:38 and transition:line:39; verify_facts shows no retention check
issues.expected: Approaching is retained while nearing destination and only exits on ready to stop/decelerate
issues.observed: Approaching has outgoing transitions to Stopping on Ready_to_Stop and to [*] on Destination_Missed with no guard expressing nearing destination retention.
issues.reason: No state invariant or guard expressing nearing destination retention is present in closed model.
issues.requirement_quote: The system remains in the Approaching substate while nearing the destination, until it is ready to stop or decelerate.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Transitions exist for exit conditions but no retention guard is modeled.
issues.title: Approaching retention while nearing destination not evidenced

issues.basis: NL4 cardinality contract NL-CONTRACT-NL4-CARD-1; inspection_equivalent_facts states InMotion outgoing_transition_refs list no containment; states parent llms_emp_feedback_final_0034 for Accelerating/Cruising/Approaching.
issues.expected: InMotion owns exactly three direct child states Accelerating, Cruising, Approaching.
